name: For You
source:
In a small town there is a shop that has a lot of girls' favorite things.

Very pretty girls are working in the shop and waiting for presents. What kinds of gifts are good for girls? If you find girl's favorite item, she can be very grateful.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-july-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
小镇里有一家商店，摆放着许多女孩喜欢的东西。

店里有非常漂亮的女孩，她们正在等待礼物。什么样的礼物才适合女孩？如果你找到某个女孩喜欢的物品，她可能会对你感激不已。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-july-1997.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
